executor: joblib threading backend, 4 threads, one at a time under the interpreter lock
notes: Parallel(n_jobs=4, prefer="threads") over delayed(job)(seed, rounds) for each input; the default loky (process) backend is not used. batch_size is left at its default (auto). The threads take turns under the interpreter lock. On PyPy joblib fails to run (AttributeError: type object 'Pickler' has no attribute 'dispatch').
